title: Postdoctoral Researcher, Abdulla Unit
institution: Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology (OIST)
about: The Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology (OIST) in Japan seeks a Postdoctoral Researcher for Prof. Ugur Abdulla's Analysis and PDE Unit. Applications are submitted through MathJobs; review starts 1 January 2027, and complete applications received by 28 February 2027 are guaranteed consideration.
